assessment: Within the available Evidence boundary, K0001-K0007 and R0001-R0005 are generally well supported and preserve important qualifications: fixed price does not imply a fully static control system; Dynamic Pricing can be a Revenue Management price control rather than a disjoint category; foundational Yield Management is capacity-allocation oriented; personalized pricing overlaps only under a broad people-driven Dynamic Pricing definition; and Price Promotion may be planned rather than state-responsive. The Synthesis also preserves terminology uncertainty. The upstream Evidence coverage gap is not independently healed here, and no additional Synthesis-only semantic distortion is identified.
